title: Core-KAN: Continuous Vision Kernels with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.19817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional convolutional kernels are typically defined on fixed discrete grids, limiting their ability to accommodate heterogeneous local structures. Existing adaptive operators improve flexibility but often couple geometric scale variation with content-dependent filtering, while incurring high computational cost from per-location kernel generation. To decouple geometric scale adaptation from content-dependent filtering while avoiding expensive per-location kernel generation, we propose Continuous Relative-scale KAN (Core-KAN), a relative-scale-conditioned continuous convolution operator. Core-KAN maps input features into a compact latent basis space and uses a lightweight scale controller to predict local scales relative to an exponential moving average reference. A KAN-based generator represents depth-wise kernel bases as continuous coordinate functions, allowing the operator to synthesize spatial filters at arbitrary resolutions r

translated_title: Core-KAN：基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的连续视觉核
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19817v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：传统卷积核通常定义在固定的离散网格上，限制了其适应异质局部结构的能力。现有自适应算子提高了灵活性，但往往将几何尺度变化与内容相关滤波耦合在一起，同时因逐位置生成核而带来高计算成本。为了解耦几何尺度适应与内容相关滤波，同时避免昂贵的逐位置核生成，我们提出了连续相对尺度KAN（Core-KAN），一种相对尺度条件的连续卷积算子。Core-KAN将输入特征映射到紧凑的潜在基空间中，并使用轻量级尺度控制器预测相对于指数移动平均参考的局部尺度。基于KAN的生成器将深度卷积核基表示为连续坐标函数，使算子能够在任意分辨率r下合成空间滤波器。
tldr: 本文提出Core-KAN，通过相对尺度条件连续卷积算子，解耦几何尺度适应与内容滤波，避免逐位置核生成，实现任意分辨率下的高效视觉滤波。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Core-KAN, a relative-scale-conditioned continuous convolution operator that decouples geometric scale adaptation from content filtering, avoiding per-location kernel generation for efficient filtering at arbitrary resolutions.
